# software id = <redacted-by-obi>
#
# model = RBD52G-5HacD2HnD
# serial number = 7D55C3817375
/interface bridge add name=bridge vlan-filtering=yes
/interface wireless set [ find default-name=wlan1 ] band=2ghz-b/g/n channel-width=20/40mhz-XX disabled=no distance=indoors frequency=auto mode=ap-bridge name=wlan2.4-evn-net-20 ssid=evn-net-21 wireless-protocol=802.11
/interface wireless set [ find default-name=wlan2 ] band=5ghz-a/n/ac channel-width=20/40mhz-XX disabled=no distance=indoors frequency=auto mode=ap-bridge name=wlan5-evn-net-20 ssid=evn-net-21 wireless-protocol=802.11
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether1 ] name=ether1-uplink
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether5 ] name=ether5-management
/interface vlan add interface=bridge name=vlan3501-manage vlan-id=3501
/interface vlan add interface=bridge name=vlan3552-guest vlan-id=3552
/interface wireless security-profiles set [ find default=yes ] authentication-types=wpa2-psk mode=dynamic-keys supplicant-identity=MikroTik
/interface wireless security-profiles add authentication-types=wpa2-psk mode=dynamic-keys name=evn-net-23 supplicant-identity=MikroTik
/interface wireless security-profiles add authentication-types=wpa2-psk mode=dynamic-keys name=evn-net-24 supplicant-identity=MikroTik
/interface wireless add disabled=no mac-address=02:5A:8F:D0:FE:D9 master-interface=wlan2.4-evn-net-20 name=wlan2.4-evn-net-24 security-profile=evn-net-24 ssid=evn-net-25 wps-mode=disabled
/interface wireless add disabled=no mac-address=02:BE:8A:5A:64:44 master-interface=wlan2.4-evn-net-20 name=wlan2.4-evn-net-23 security-profile=evn-net-23 ssid="evn-net-26" wps-mode=disabled
/ip pool add name=guest ranges=172.21.164.100-172.21.167.250
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether2 pvid=3501
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether3 pvid=3501
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether4 pvid=3501
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=wlan2.4-evn-net-20 pvid=3501
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=wlan5-evn-net-20 pvid=3501
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether1-uplink pvid=3501
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether5-management pvid=3501
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=wlan2.4-evn-net-23 pvid=3552
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=wlan2.4-evn-net-24 pvid=3552
/ip neighbor discovery-settings set discover-interface-list=!dynamic
/ipv6 settings set disable-ipv6=yes
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge tagged=bridge vlan-ids=3501
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge tagged=bridge vlan-ids=3552
/ip address add address=172.21.164.1/22 interface=vlan3552-guest network=172.21.164.0
/ip dhcp-client add interface=vlan3501-manage
/ip dhcp-server add address-pool=guest interface=vlan3552-guest name=guest
/ip dhcp-server network add address=172.21.164.0/22 dns-server=198.51.100.1,192.0.2.8 gateway=172.21.164.1
/ip firewall filter add action=fasttrack-connection chain=forward connection-state=established,related hw-offload=yes
/ip firewall filter add action=accept chain=forward connection-state=established,related
/ip firewall nat add action=masquerade chain=srcnat out-interface=vlan3501-manage src-address=172.21.164.0/22
/system clock set time-zone-name=America/Los_Angeles
/system identity set name=noc-ap-birch
/system logging add action=disk topics=critical
/system logging add action=disk topics=error
/system logging add action=disk topics=info
/system logging add action=disk topics=warning
/system logging add action=disk topics=critical
/system logging add action=disk topics=error
/system logging add action=disk topics=info
/system logging add action=disk topics=warning
/system note set show-at-login=no
/system ntp client set enabled=yes
/system routerboard settings set auto-upgrade=yes
/tool bandwidth-server set authenticate=no
/tool graphing interface add
/tool graphing resource add
/tool romon set enabled=yes
/tool sniffer set file-name=noc-ap-birch.pcap filter-interface=vlan3552-guest
